name: jellyfin-haptic-player
description: HAPPY is a self-hosted haptic player for audio and video files.

scripts.build:client: npm run build:css && NODE_ENV=production node scripts/build-client.js --minify --sourcemap
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:vendor
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p sandbox/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: NODE_ENV=test node --import tsx --test $(find test/client test/scripts dglab-relay/test -name '*.test.ts')
scripts.test:coverage: mkdir -p coverage && NODE_ENV=test node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='src/**' --test-coverage-include='dglab-relay/src/**' --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info $(find test/client test/scripts dglab-relay/test -name '*.test.ts')
scripts.test:watch: NODE_ENV=test node --import tsx --test --watch $(find test/client test/scripts dglab-relay/test -name '*.test.ts')
